capabilities.name: clipboard.read
capabilities.description: Read the current clipboard contents.

capabilities.name: clipboard.write
capabilities.description: Write text or an image to the clipboard.

capabilities.name: clipboard.paste
capabilities.description: Paste into the previously focused application.

capabilities.name: selectedText.read
capabilities.description: Read selected text through the Accessibility permission.

capabilities.name: open.url
capabilities.description: Open a URL in the default browser.

capabilities.name: open.application
capabilities.description: Open an installed application.

capabilities.name: finder.reveal
capabilities.description: Reveal a local path in Finder.

capabilities.name: storage.read
capabilities.description: Read extension-scoped persistent storage.

capabilities.name: storage.write
capabilities.description: Write extension-scoped persistent storage.

capabilities.name: storage.delete
capabilities.description: Delete an extension-scoped storage value.

capabilities.name: preferences.read
capabilities.description: Read declared extension preferences.

capabilities.name: process.execute
capabilities.description: Run an allowlisted process with argument and output limits.

capabilities.name: process.inspect
capabilities.description: Read a bounded snapshot of running process metadata.

capabilities.name: process.terminate
capabilities.description: Terminate an explicitly selected process or its descendants.

capabilities.name: process.restart
capabilities.description: Terminate and relaunch an explicitly selected process.

capabilities.name: process.cancel
capabilities.description: Cancel a running extension process job owned by this extension.

capabilities.name: ports.inspect
capabilities.description: Read listening TCP ports and their owning process IDs.

capabilities.name: system.metrics.read
capabilities.description: Read local CPU, memory, disk, power and network metrics.

capabilities.name: network.request
capabilities.description: Make a network request after the provider and data flow are disclosed.

capabilities.name: menuBar.publishSnapshot
capabilities.description: Publish a native menu-bar snapshot for this extension.
